title: Nice comforter set for the price.
text:
Nice comforter set for the price.. Well made for the price. The colors are beautiful! I do wish they would quilt these comforters more. It would help stop the batting from bunching up while washing. If you take the time to add in a few quilting lines, you'll have an awesome comforter. I know they make most of them like this, but it could be so much better with more quilting done. I would feel better washing it.

Light weight, yet warm.

product_metadata.title: Vue Karma Bedding Set with 2 Coordinating Shams, King, Blue
features: Twin Size is sold as 2-piece set
Queen and King sizes are sold as 3-piece sets
Coordinating shower curtain available, sold separately
description: High fashion design meets imaginative and spontaneous style with the Vue Karma love 3-piece reversible comforter set. This trendy comforter features allover Bohemian medallions with a stylized bottom trim. Reverse features abstract print in coordinating colors. Twin XL comforter set includes one 68x90 reversible comforter and one 20x26 standard sham. Full/queen comforter set includes one 90x90 reversible comforter and two 20x26 standard shams. King comforter set includes one 102x90 reversible comforter and two 20x36 King shams. Shams are random cut and may appear differently than image shown. Set is 100Percent polyester. Machine washable.
